classification: kdotpy material parameters for the NC EI Stage-B attempt

GaSb.gamma2_policy: Du2017 table typo correction inferred from gamma2_L - Ep/(6 Eg); not author-confirmed

Ep_source: Li, Yang, and Chang, Phys. Rev. B 80, 035303 (2009), cited as Ref. 7 by the Nature supplement: Ep=22.5 eV for each material
caveat: Supplementary Table 1 does not itself list P/Ep, lattice/elastic constants, kappa, or BIA parameters. Ep is author-method-reference supplied; lattice/elastic constants remain external approximations and unsupported BIA/deformation terms are zeroed. GaSb gamma2=8.18 is retained as the printed value, while the optional inferred model uses 0.08 from 4.7 - 22.5/(6*0.812) = 0.0817734; this correction is not author-confirmed and must be selected explicitly.
